chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi al-Jarood, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him), from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, who said:

I entered upon Fatima (peace be upon her), and in front of her was a tablet containing the names of the Trustees (al-Awsiyah'). I counted twelve, the last of whom is the Riser (al-Qa'im). Three of them were Muhammad (peace be upon him), and four of them were Ali (peace be upon him).

key_terms.الْأَوْصِيَاءِ: The Trustees or Successors, referring to the Imams
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Riser, a title for the twelfth Imam
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fatima bint Muhammad (peace be upon her)
key_terms.لَوْحٌ: A tablet or board, here referring to a physical object containing written names

ai.seo_question: What are the names of the twelve Trustees (Awsiyah) mentioned in the tablet of Fatima?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* provides a crucial link between the Prophet’s household and the doctrine of the Twelve Imams, presenting Fatima (peace be upon her) as the custodian of a divine tablet listing the *Awsiyah* (Trustees). The specific enumeration of three Muhammads and four Alis underscores the centrality of these two names in the Imamate, while identifying the final Imam as al-Qa'im establishes the continuity of leadership up to the present day. This serves as a foundational proof (*hujjah*) for the Twelver Shia belief in the infallible succession of the Imams.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 6-6 Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his father quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Al-Hussein ibn Abil Khattab, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn Mahboob, on the authority of Abil Jarood, on the authority of Abi Ja’far (s), on the authority of Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari, “I went to see (the Blessed Lady) Fatima (s).

There was a tablet in front of her in which there were the names of the Trustees. There were twelve names - the last one of which is the Riser. Three of them were Muhammad (s) and four of them were Ali (s).”
